name: termcp-desktop
description: Termcp desktop manager and SSH workspace

scripts.dev: npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && go run github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@v2.15.0 build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run build && go test ./...
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run check && npm test && go vet ./...
